auditor_eric: Hi team — auditor follow-up for INC-2025-03. We need a compact evidence bundle for the RBAC remediation: the rolebinding change diff + PR approval trail, KMS usage logs for the service account key, SIEM export showing who called Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, and a manifest with checksums and signature. Also need a one-page control mapping to SOC2 control IDs. Can you provide timeline and artifacts?

lina (eng-security): Sure. We'll assemble a bundle and include a short mapping doc. Quick summary: the RBAC tweak was done in infra PR #512 to tighten the service-account role, reviewers were @omar and @kai. I'll pull the GitHub review history and a rolebinding kubectl diff.

lina (eng-security): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/9c7d5f1 (contains rolebinding delta and reviewer comments).

omar (infra): KMS context: the workload uses envelope encryption with CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-9abc. Access patterns show GenerateDataKey calls at write time and Decrypt at read. CloudTrail will have the events. We'll include the minimal redacted lines. Example redacted CloudTrail record:
```
eventTime=2025-03-14T10:15:03Z eventName=GenerateDataKey userIdentity.arn=arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/service-role/sa-processor sessionContext.sessionIssuer.type=Role sourceIPAddress=34.201.12.5 requestParameters.keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-9abc
```

kai (sre): For SIEM proof I used this Splunk search over the incident window and exported CSV:
```
index=aws_cloudtrail (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt) AND requestParameters.keyId=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/cmk-9abc\" | stats count by userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName, eventName, _time | sort _time
```
Export location: s3://redwood-evidence/incidents/INC-2025-03/siem-export-24h.csv

evidence-bot: Evidence job queued -> bundle=pack-1765010001 files=[rbac-diff.txt, pr-512-reviews.png, k8s-audit-snip.json.gz, cloudtrail-kms.csv, siem-export-24h.csv, control-mapping.pdf, manifest.sha256, manifest.sig] destination=s3://redwood-evidence/exports/pack-1765010001.tar.gz

lina (eng-security): k8s audit slice path: s3://redwood-logs/k8s-audit/2025/03/14/audit-slice-10-*.json.gz. The kubectl diff I ran is in rbac-diff.txt. Sample diff line:
```
- kind: RoleBinding
  metadata:
    name: sa-processor-binding
    namespace: processing
  subjects:
-   - kind: ServiceAccount
+   - kind: ServiceAccount
      name: sa-processor
      namespace: processing
  roleRef:
-   name: cluster-admin
+   name: namespace-reader
```

omar (infra): CMK is shared by a few services in the account; policy restricts Decrypt to a named IAM role set. We'll include the minimal policy snippet and the key tags showing owner=processing-service.

auditor_eric: Two quick Qs: (1) Is the PR approval chain preserved (who approved and when)? (2) Do you have signed manifest using an internal key? We require SHA256 + signature.

lina (eng-security): (1) Yes — GitHub review history exported as pr-512-reviews.png and the commit has timestamp 2025-03-14T10:18:21Z with approvers omar and kai. (2) We'll sign the manifest with our internal GPG key (key id 0xD09F2E1B) and include README.md mapping each file to SOC2 control clauses (e.g., CC6.1: change approvals, CC7.1: crypto key access controls).

kai (sre): Incident timeline short:
- 2025-03-14T09:56Z: CVE alert triggered -> INC-2025-03 created
- 2025-03-14T10:07Z: Triage concluded privileged SA had overly broad role
- 2025-03-14T10:12Z: PR #512 opened to narrow rolebinding
- 2025-03-14T10:18Z: PR approved and merged
- 2025-03-14T10:14Z to 2025-03-14T10:45Z: KMS events observed (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt)
- 2025-03-14T11:05Z: Post-change sampling and verification complete
No evidence of misuse during window.

lina (eng-security): We'll include a short CSV mapping each artifact to SOC2 language (control_id, artifact, explanation). Example mapping row: CC6.1, pr-512-reviews.png, "Shows design/approval for RBAC change and reviewer identity and timestamp"

auditor_eric: That looks good. Please ensure the manifest lists SHA256 of each file and the signature is detached. Also include a presigned S3 URL that is valid for 7 days.

evidence-bot: Bundle ready -> presigned_url=https://s3-presigned.redwood/pack-1765010001.tar.gz?X-Expires=604800, manifest=manifest.sha256, signature=manifest.sig

lina (eng-security): Uploaded. I'm posting the presigned link and will DM the auditor the GPG public key fingerprint: D09F 2E1B 89C3 4A5F. If you want additional sampling windows or a different signer, ping here.

auditor_eric: Thanks. Follow-up: can you add a short note that CMK is not dedicated and how you restrict Decrypt in the policy? Need that for control mapping.

omar (infra): Will do. I'll paste the minimal policy snippet into control-mapping.pdf and note that Decrypt is limited to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/processing-decrypt-role and that key usage is tagged with environment=prod,owner=processing.

auditor_eric: Perfect. Closing for now — will review the pack and get back if anything else is needed. :white_check_mark:
